image_activation.source_requirement: Legitimate Kenyan supplier/manufacturer product page whose title or URL explicitly matches exact product name/model and pack size.
image_activation.storage_verification: Storage object exists and exact stored URL is referenced in products.images.
image_activation.activation: Set active=true immediately after source identity, technical image, storage reference, price, SEO and regulatory gates pass.
image_activation.missing_or_mismatched_image: Keep inactive; do not use generic substitutes.

regulatory_gate: PCPB registration, registered use, exact product identity and label restrictions remain mandatory; this image rule does not waive regulatory checks.
scud_exception: Keep SCUD 5 WP variants inactive until 50g/kg versus 50g/L concentration discrepancy is resolved from the physical Kenyan label.
